name: Genes
title: Gene Pool: this Rouh in the Gene Pool on rouh.land, and shared genes from a registry, read before they are installed, and the lab they arrive in

permissions: fetches a gene registry's signed index and blocklist, and a gene's files, from the address set here, hourly and when asked
installs a gene into the lab only when an administrator says yes on its page, switched off, and never runs its files
switches a gene off by itself when the registry's blocklist names it, and tells the person who installed it
accounts: the gene registry set in Rouh Land Account, Gene Pool (none until one is set)
jobs: the gene lab's look at its registry, hourly (genelab.Watch)
touches.remove: Turn the registry off in Rouh Land Account, Gene Pool and remove each gene in the lab there, then delete rouh/genelab.py, rouh/web/genes.py, genespage.js/.css, the gene-pool section in rouh/templates/rouh/index.html, the gene-pool entries in app/runs.js, the shared genes in rouh/genes (extra), and this manifest; drop the three tables with a migration.
